entry.title: FastAPI Background Tasks for LLM Apps

media:group.media:title: FastAPI Background Tasks for LLM Apps
media:group.media:description:
Long LLM calls should not block your API. In this video we move slow work into FastAPI background tasks, add a simple job table so clients can poll for results, and discuss when to switch to a real task queue.
Chapters: 0:00 Why requests time out 3:20 BackgroundTasks basics 9:45 Polling for results 15:10 When you need a task queue
